pageCache.pageTitle: Physical Education - Subjects - Beckley C of E Primary School
pageCache.text:
Physical Education
Physical Education (P.E.) is taught from Reception to Year 6. The school works in partnership with specialist coaches from Elite Youth Sports (https://www.eliteyouthsports.co.uk/) to deliver each class from Year 1 to Year 6 two formal hours of P.E. teaching a week. Pupils in Reception receive one formal hour of P.E. teaching, and consistent access to outdoor fine and gross motor skill development through continuous provision in the outdoor area. P.E. is led by the Science and Technology Team.
To find out more about our extensive extra-curricular Sport activities, visit our Personal Development page.

pageCache.pageTitle: Headteacher's Welcome - Beckley C of E Primary School
pageCache.text:
Headteacher's Welcome
Welcome to Beckley Church of England Primary School.
Beckley is a brilliant place to learn. We are nestled in the beautiful Oxfordshire countryside, with spectacular views across Otmoor. Our school is made up of learners who are enthusiastic, engaged and polite from Beckley itself, the villages of Forest Hill, Elsfield, Stanton St. John, Horton-cum-Studley, as well as surrounding areas and Oxford city.
At Beckley, we truly believe that high expectations for every single learner is at the root of an outstanding primary education, and this forms the basis of our vision - Soar on Wings Like Eagles (Isaiah 40:31). There is no barrier too great to stop us getting the absolute best out of everybody here, and our dedicated team of teachers and support colleagues go above and beyond to provide a curriculum that is broad, enriching, and allows all learners to soar high. We believe that everybody should leave our school with knowledge, skills and memories that last a lifetime!
We have productive and exciting links with the wider community, including dedicated governors, other schools in the River Learning Trust, loyal parents, and the Church. The Christian values of kindness, courage and responsibility underpin everything we do at Beckley, and visitors often comment on the compassion and warmth shown by everybody at our school.
We hope our website gives you an insight into what a special place Beckley is, but we would really like to welcome you in person. Please call or drop by to arrange a visit and I would be happy to show you around our stunning grounds and introduce you to our brilliant learners and colleagues.
At Beckley, pupils are welcoming and happy. Everyone belongs here. Leaders want pupils to be ‘well-rounded, thoughtful and kind’, and they are.
(Pupils..) “are motivated and excited to learn.”
“Ensuring the safety of pupils is a top priority at this school.”
“Children take pride in their achievements and support one another when they find things challenging…”
Wellbeing is a strength of the school and fundamental to its ethos. Kindness, consistent with the school’s vision, is readily and clearly demonstrated across the community. Behaviour at Beckley School is calm and respectful and makes a significant contribution to the atmosphere of learning. The school is creating a community that aptly expresses dignity and respect to all and where all can flourish
- SIAMS January 2020
Our School Prayer
This is our school Let peace dwell here Let the room be full of contentment Let love be here Love of one another Love of mankind And love of God Let us remember That as many hands build a house So many hearts make a school

pageCache.pageTitle: Breakfast and After-School Club - Beckley C of E Primary School
pageCache.text:
Breakfast and After-School Club
We offer high-quality wraparound care to all pupils from Reception to Year 6.
Breakfast Club is run by school staff. Sessions start from 8.00am, run until the start of the school day and cost £7.00 per pupil, per session. There is a 50% sibling discount for Breakfast Club.
Our After School Club sessions run from the end of the school day until 5.30pm and costs £10.00 per pupil, per session.
Both clubs conform to all of our policies and procedures. Places are restricted for pupil safety and to ensure adequate staffing and must be booked in advance. We accept childcare vouchers, please contact the office for details.
Browese the Breakfast Club and After School Club menus here.
We also have a range of Extra-Curricular Activities, which you can browse here and read more about on our 'Personal Development' page.

Personal Development
At Beckley Primary School, we deliver our Personal Development offer to all pupils through eight strands:
Find out more about our Personal Development Intent, and Implementation of the eight strands here: Personal Development At-a-Glance
For our PSHE and RSHE learning, we use a programme called 'SCARF'. Find out more here.
As part of our Personal Development, we encourage pupils to be 'Active Learners' and solve problems themselves before asking for help. We do this through the "5 Beckley B's", which are displayed in every classroom. View the 5 B's here.
Browse our current offer of Personal Development Activities here: Personal Development Extra-Curricular Activity Brochure
Miss Wilkie is the Personal Development Lead for the school.
Find out more about the specific teaching of PSHE and RSHE at Beckley on our 'Subjects' page.
